concept: S3 encryption: enforce SSE-KMS via default encryption + bucket policy
tests: How to guarantee every object is encrypted with a customer managed KMS key and reject uploads without SSE.
expected: Default encryption SSE-KMS with a CMK + bucket policy Deny s3:PutObject when the x-amz-server-side-encryption header is missing/wrong. Triggers: "customer managed KMS key", "upload without encryption is rejected".
why_not: SSE-S3 doesn't use a customer managed key; versioning doesn't encrypt; a Lambda that deletes objects after upload leaves a window of unencrypted storage.
